_note: How the text box writes: letters per second, and a short extra wait after punctuation so sentences breathe. A press shows the rest of the line at once.
_hearts: The heart on the name tag when a villager speaks (Game.heart_band, bands in data/villagers/_common.json): one fill colour per band, 0 = an empty paper heart, then warmer and deeper reds up to the seal's vermilion and a dark crimson with a gold glint for band 6. Ours, picked to sit on the wooden tag.
